description: This file contains test cases for the ToolResultTextFormatter component, verifying its behavior with plain text, JSON summaries, error messages, and unknown payloads.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: Test suite verifying the behavior of ToolResultTextFormatter's format method.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Tests that plain text input remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Tests that JSON containing nodes information is summarized correctly by the formatter.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Tests that error JSON is summarized properly and agent prefixes are dropped.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Tests that unknown JSON payloads result in empty output.
